label: computer screen
text: The top corner of a dark teal editor window fills the lower half of the frame, with three small coloured buttons, a title bar and an open tab above the first line of text. Above it, a warm amber strip of lamplit wood or trim catches the light against deep black. The pixel lines of the display are visible across the teal, and the cream lettering softens quickly towards the bottom edge. Analogue film adds heavy grain in the black areas.

label: computer screen
text: A tilted view of a teal editor shows a rounded search bar with grey placeholder wording, a file heading marked by a cream dot, and the first three numbered lines beneath. A strip of dark textured trim catches amber light along the top, with a band of pure black between it and the screen. The lettering is bold and crisp in the middle and slides out of focus at the corners. The analogue film frame carries visible grain and a cool teal cast against the warm amber edge.

label: computer screen
text: A rounded search bar with pale grey placeholder text crosses the top of a dark teal editor, above a single file heading marked with a cream dot. Below that, three numbered lines begin in lime green and pink. Fine horizontal stripes run across the screen and the lettering melts into a soft blur towards the edges. Taken on analogue film, the picture carries visible grain and a slight green tint over the shadows.

label: playground slide tower
text: White lattice tower rises on the right, with a curving blue slide wrapping around its base, set against a sky of soft white clouds on a clear blue ground. Bright daylight lights the tower's grid of squares and the glossy turquoise slide, and a few colourful shapes show near the top of the tower. Rooftops and a blue building appear at the very bottom and right edges. The sky takes most of the frame, which puts the tower in the right-hand third and leaves a wide area of open blue. There is visible analogue film grain across the sky, with fresh, saturated blues.

label: velvet ribbon bow
text: A bow of green velvet ribbon sits against a red flocked surface, its wired edges catching a lime highlight along every loop. The nap of the velvet looks dense and slightly furred, and the red flock below carries a few pale specks of dust or glitter. Focus falls on the near loops and the right-hand tail, while the knot and the large red shape at the right soften into blur. Honey-toned display lamps keep the reds deep and turn the green yellowish. Shot on analogue film, it has heavy grain and a bright halo along the lightest edges.

label: striped fabric texture
text: Broad red and off-white stripes sweep across the frame with a gentle wave, as though the material was loosely draped or bent. The white bands show a fine pinprick dot texture, and the red is deep and even. Soft overhead light leaves very little shadow, so the surface looks calm and slightly matt. The nearest stripe edges stay crisp while the corners fall a little soft. Shot on analogue film, the fine grain breaks up the flat red and off-white.
